description.value: This Subway franchise sits on 97th Avenue in Fort St. John, a Highway 97 corridor city that serves as a major service hub for cyclists on the Alaska Highway route. As an independently owned and operated franchise, it offers sandwiches, wraps, and salads with options for pickup, delivery, and curbside service. Its practical location in a commercial strip makes it a potential quick resupply stop for northbound or southbound touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (10008 97th Ave, Fort St John, BC V1J 5P3) and phone number ((250) 785-1750) match the OSM tags. However, the Store Hours table on the Subway location page explicitly lists all seven days (Mon–Sun) as 'Closed,' which strongly conflicts with the OSM opening_hours tags and raises a serious concern that this location may be permanently closed; the repeated 'Open 24 Hours' text appearing on the same page appears to be a website rendering artifact unrelated to this specific location's hours. OSM confirms toilets=yes and takeaway=yes, and the website corroborates curbside pickup and in-restaurant dining services.
concerns: Website Store Hours table lists all days (Mon–Sun) as 'Closed,' directly contradicting OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 05:30-21:00; Sa-Su 07:00-21:00) and suggesting possible permanent closure.
Contradictory website content: 'Open 24 Hours' text appears repeatedly on the same page alongside the all-Closed hours table — likely a rendering/template artifact, but adds uncertainty.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Subway location page's Store Hours table lists all seven days (Mon–Sun) as 'Closed,' strongly suggesting this location may be permanently closed. On-the-ground or phone verification is needed before any listing decision.
